title.rendered: Dinner Night Out at Baja Fresh!

content.rendered:
Join us on May 21st, starting at 4:00pm, for DNO at Sherwood Baja Fresh!  A portion of the proceeds will be donated to Hawks View PAC.  Mention the fundraiser to the cashier when ordering in-store.  Or, order online using the steps below:

  1. Order online at order.BajaFresh.com
  2. Select the store address (16002 SW Tualatin Sherwood Rd)
  3. Enter Coupon Code BajaFunds at checkout
